source: Zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: Chos nyid bar do'i gsal 'debs thos grol chen mo, pages 72–79 of the reproduction, from an undated Tibetan blockprint of the Thos grol cycle reproduced by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center as W23710 (text kha), read from the page images. It is a traditional blockprint, so no modern editor's work is involved. Two transcriptions found online, one of this print and one of another, were used to check the reading and are not the text. The page gives the print's wording and spelling. Three things are ours: the spaces between words, which Tibetan does not write; the line-end abbreviations, written out; and clear misprints corrected, each named in its note. Where another print reads differently in a way that matters, the note says so. Letters: the Wylie system (Extended Wylie for the Sanskrit words). Pronunciation: the reading style of central Tibet in the THL Simplified Phonetic Transcription (Germano and Tournadre, 2003), produced by rule from the spelling; a living reader's pronunciation will differ in places. The translation is new, made from the Tibetan. sentences.l: Maṇḍala that's east from, On-the-Levels Dwelling's knowledge-holder so-called, body-colour white and smiling's radiance with endowed, mother sky-goer white body to embracing and, curved-knife and skull-blood's dance making, and, gazing-manner's seal sky-to making, one, dawning comes.
sentences.i: From the east of that maṇḍala dawns the knowledge-holder called Dwelling on the Levels, his body white, with a smiling radiance; his consort, a white sky-goer, embraces him, and he dances with the curved knife and the skull full of blood, making the gesture of gazing toward the sky.
sentences.n: The four knowledge-holders of the directions, round the one of full ripening in the centre, who closed the last part; each has the same five phrases. sa la gnas pa'i, 'dwelling on the sa': sa is 'earth, ground', and also the word for the levels (Sanskrit bhūmi) of a bodhisattva's path, and the name is taken in that sense; 'Dwelling on the Earth' is the plain sense of the words. Four of the five names, full ripening (in the centre), power over life, the great seal and spontaneous presence, are elsewhere the usual list of the stages a knowledge-holder reaches; Dwelling on the Levels, the fifth here, is read with them, and the text itself does not explain the names. 'dzum pa'i mdangs, 'a smiling radiance'. yum mkha' 'gro dkar mo has mkha' 'gro without -ma, where the other three have mkha' 'gro ma; the sense is the same. 'khril zhing, 'embracing, and', where the others have 'khril ba. gri gug dang thod khrag gi gar mdzad, 'makes the dance of the curved knife and the skull of blood', the dance done with them in the hands; the next three vary the particle (gis 'with', gi again, 'dzin pas 'holding'). Who dances is not said; the knowledge-holder is taken. The other recension has lta stangs for blta stangs (007) here and in the next three.

sentences.n: tshe la dbang ba, 'having power over life' (tshe, 'life'; dbang ba, 'to have power'), the knowledge-holder who has mastered his own lifespan. dpe byad, 'the minor marks', the eighty lesser signs of a buddha's body beside the thirty-two major ones; mdzes pa'i, 'beautiful'. sku mdog is doubtful on the image ([?]): the o-stroke of mdog stands where the tail of a letter on the line above also reaches; it is read as the vowel, which the sense needs (the transcription of this print has mdag, no word). ldan ba is the print's spelling of ldan pa, and gcig, 'one', its spelling of cig, here only in the five phrases; both are kept. gis, 'with, by', where the first had gi.

'dzin pas, 'by holding', where the others have gi or gis.

sentences.l: Knowledge-holders those (plural)'s side-at(?), sky-goer-women's hosts measure-to without and; charnel-grounds eight's sky-goers; families four's sky-goers; places three sky-goers; places ten's sky-goers; lands twenty-four's sky-goers (plural) and; heroes and; heroines and; ging and; dharma-protecting's guardians with together, all, bone's ornaments six wearing, then,
sentences.i: Around those knowledge-holders are hosts of sky-goers beyond measure: the sky-goers of the eight charnel grounds, of the four families, of the three places, of the ten places and of the twenty-four lands, with heroes and heroines, ging, and the guardians who protect the teaching. All of them wear the six bone ornaments,
sentences.n: The print has དབག (dbag), a misprint for དཔག (dpag), corrected here: dpag tu med pa, 'immeasurable', as the print itself writes it three lines below. The print has མཁའ་གྲོ (mkha' gro), a misprint for མཁའ་འགྲོ (mkha' 'gro), corrected here: the a-chung is dropped, and the word stands four more times in the same list. rnams kyi rol du is kept as printed: rol is 'side', so 'on their side, round them', but the usual word is phyi rol, 'outside'; the other recension has phyi rim du, 'in the outer ring', and the sense is about the same. The lists are of sacred places where sky-goers live: dur khrod brgyad, 'the eight charnel grounds'; rigs bzhi, 'the four families'; gnas gsum, gnas bcu and yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi, 'the three places, the ten places, the twenty-four lands', the sacred sites of the tantras. What the four families and the three and ten places are, the text does not say. dpa' bo and dpa' mo, 'heroes' and 'heroines' (dpa' bo, Sanskrit vīra), in the tantras the male and female companions of the sky-goers. ging, a class of wild dancing attendants in the retinue of the wrathful deities; the word is left untranslated. chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma, 'guardians who protect the teaching'; the other recension srung ma. dang bcas pa thams cad, 'all of them, together with'. rus pa'i rgyan drug, 'the six ornaments of bone' worn by tantric figures; gsol, the respectful 'wear'. The transcription of this print skips dpa' bo dang, which is on the image, as in the other recension.

sentences.i: and with drums, thigh-bone trumpets and skull drums, banners of flayed skin, canopies and pennants of human skin, the smoke of burnt offerings of human flesh, and music of countless kinds, they come, filling all the realms of the world, shaking, swaying and quivering.
sentences.n: Each thing they bring is a noun with dang, 'and', and a ༔. rnga, 'drum'; rkang dung, 'thigh-bone trumpet' (rkang, 'leg-bone'; dung, 'horn'); thod rnga, 'skull drum', a small double-headed drum made of skulls. zhing lpags: lpags is 'skin'; zhing, 'field', is in tantric speech also the body of an enemy to be slain, and the word is taken as a flayed skin of that kind; the sense is not sure. rgyal mtshan, 'victory banner'. mi lpags, 'human skin'. mi[?]: an ink blot covers the vowel on the image, and mi is read as in the two words after it. bla bres, 'canopy' (the other recension bla re). 'phan, 'pennant'. gsur is a burnt offering, flour and food burnt for its smoke; mi gsur, 'a burnt offering of human (flesh)', taken so, with dud pa, 'smoke'. rol mo'i bye brag, 'kinds of music'. khengs pa, 'filling, filled'. shig shig, yom yom, 'gul 'gul: three doubled words of motion, 'shaking', 'swaying', 'quivering'; du, 'in the manner of', joins them to 'ong. The print sets ༔ after shig shig; the other recension has khengs par phyed༔ shig shig yom yom, with phyed, 'half', and the ༔ a word earlier.

sentences.l: O child-of-noble-family! Habitual-tendencies in-the-expanse purified, coemergent's wisdom's colours five with endowed, coloured-thread twisted like, mottled-shimmering, flickering, gleaming(?), one(?): bright and clear, lustrous and fearsome, one,
sentences.i: O child of noble family, the habitual tendencies purified in the expanse, a light of the five colours of coemergent wisdom, like twisted coloured threads, mottled and shimmering, flickering, gleaming, bright and clear, lustrous and fearsome,
sentences.n: The subject of a long phrase, whose verb comes in the next sentence; the print has no word for 'light' (the other recension has ye shes 'od kha dog lnga, 'a wisdom light of five colours'). bag chags dbyings su dag pa, 'habitual tendencies purified in the expanse', as on this day's first page (007). lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes, 'coemergent wisdom' (lhan cig, 'together'; skyes pa, 'born'; Sanskrit sahaja), the wisdom born together with the mind itself. mtshon skud is taken as tshon skud, 'coloured thread' (tshon, 'colour, dye'; skud, 'thread'), which the other recension has; mtshon is 'weapon' or 'sign'. sgril ma, 'twisted, rolled'. Three doubled-sound words for the play of the light, their senses approximate: khra shig shig pa, khra 'mottled, many-coloured' with shig shig 'quivering'; mer mer ba, 'flickering', as flames do; phyam phyam pa, taken as 'gleaming', not sure. gcig, 'one', after them belongs with the words before: the other recension has phyam phyam pa zhig, 'a gleaming one', and the print's ༔ falls a word early; the translation leaves it out. gsal la dwangs pa, bkrag la nyam nga ba, 'bright and clear, lustrous and fearsome', as on the days before (gsal la dwangs pa in 004–006, bkrag la nyam nga ba'i in 007). sentences.i: you know me: a being like me, who has gathered no accumulations; who until these days has been held by the compassion of so many deities of the five families of sugatas of the three times, and yet was not caught; one like me, alas!
sentences.n: The print has བདེ་གཤིགས (bde gshigs), a misprint for བདེ་གཤེགས (bde gshegs), corrected here; bde gshegs is short for bde bar gshegs pa, 'sugata' (007), which the other recension has. khyed rnams mkhyen, 'you (all) know', with mkhyen, the respectful 'know': the appeal of a prayer, 'take heed of me'; the other recension has re mkhyen, 'I rely on you, you know'. tshogs ma bsags pa, 'who has not gathered the accumulations', of merit and wisdom (bsags, the past stem of gsog, 'to gather': gsog / bsags / bsag / sogs). da zhag phan chad du, 'up to these days now' (da, 'now'; zhag, 'day'; phan chad du, 'up to'), the days of the bardo just past; the reading is not sure. dus gsum, 'the three times', past, present and future. de tsam cig gi, 'of so many', with thugs rjes, 'by the compassion'. bzung yang ma zin pa, 'held, yet not caught' (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin; zin, 'be caught'): the deities held him and he slipped away. sentences.l:
Alas! Knowledge-holder deity-hosts (plural) also, heed I-pray!
Love great-by the-way leading I-pray!
Habitual-tendencies fierce-by in-saṃsāra wandering's time,
coemergent wisdom bright's light-path on,
heroes, knowledge-holders, host's(?) the-way lead!
Mothers supreme, sky-goers' host by, from-behind support!
The between fearful's narrow-passage from having-freed, also,
pure Sky-Faring realm that-to bring!
sentences.i:
Alas! Hosts of knowledge-holder deities, I pray you, think of me;
I pray you, lead the way in your great love.
When I wander in saṃsāra through fierce habitual tendencies,
on the bright light-path of coemergent wisdom
may the host of heroes and knowledge-holders lead the way,
may the host of sky-goers, the supreme mothers, support me from behind;
and when you have freed me from the fearful narrow passage of the bardo,
bring me to that pure Sky-Faring realm.
sentences.n: The prayer of the seventh day, on the pattern of the days before (007): nine syllables to the line after kyai ma, here in eight lines. dgongs su gsol, 'I pray, think (of me)': dgongs, the respectful 'think, have in mind'. brtse ba chen pos, 'by great love'. drang du gsol, 'I pray that you lead', and drongs, the imperative of 'dren, 'lead!'. lhan skyes, short for lhan cig skyes pa, 'coemergent'. dpa' bo rig 'dzin tshogs kyi lam sna drongs: the print has kyi, 'of', where the other recension has rnams kyis, 'by', marking the leaders, as mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis does in the next line; kyi is taken as standing for kyis, as the print elsewhere writes gi for gis (gcig gi in the pilot), and 005 read yi as yis in its prayer. Read as printed, it would be 'lead the way of the host'. yum mchog, 'supreme mothers', the consorts. skyor, 'support!', as in 007. bsgral nas kyang, 'and having freed', bsgral the past stem of sgrol. skyol, the imperative of skyel, 'bring!' (skyel / bskyal / bskyal / skyol). de ru, 'to that', ru after a vowel. The other recension writes kye ma for kyai ma and drangs for drang.

sentences.i: All that stands above, the recognition of the clear light in the bardo of the moment of death and the pointing-out of the peaceful bardo of reality, the Great Liberation through Hearing, is finished.
sentences.n: The close of text kha, the text that began with the title in the pilot. de yan chad, 'that and everything above it' (yan chad, 'from … upward'). 'od gsal ngo 'phrod pa, 'the recognition of the clear light', with ngo 'phrod, the recognition that comes, against ngo sprad pa, 'the pointing-out', in the second item; the other recension has ngo sprad pa in both, and bar dor for bar do la. chos nyid zhi ba'i bar do, 'the peaceful bardo of reality', the bardo of the peaceful deities, the subject of the parts since 002. thal lo: thal is 'to pass through, to have gone by'; with the sentence-ending -lo it is taken as a closing word, 'it is finished, it has gone through'; the sense is not sure. sentences.n: ཨྠྀི is one stack: ཨ (a) with ཐ (tha) under it, and two i-vowels above, a reversed gi-gu and a gi-gu, one for each letter. So it spells i-thi, Sanskrit iti, 'thus', the word that closes a Sanskrit text, written as one sign; treasure texts close with it. rgya, 'seal' (Sanskrit mudrā), three times: the threefold seal at the end of a treasure text, said to mark it as sealed in secrecy and entrusted; its meaning is explained in more than one way. A last ༔ stands faint against the frame. Text kha ends here, on p. 79, a page of three lines; the wrathful deities follow on the next leaf as text ga.

glossary.ཆོས: chos — thing, phenomenon; the teaching (Sanskrit dharma) · reality, what is true (chos): chos kyi rang sgra 'the own sound of reality'
glossary.ཆོས་ཉིད: chos nyid — reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
glossary.ཆོས་སྐྱོང་བའི: chos skyong ba'i — of those who protect the teaching (chos 'teaching' + skyong ba 'to protect' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཉམ་ང་བ: nyam nga ba — fearsome, dreadful (nyam nga ba): bkrag la nyam nga ba 'lustrous and fearsome'
glossary.ཉི་ཤུ་རྩ་བཞིའི: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i — of twenty-four (nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'twenty-four' + -'i 'of'): the twenty-four lands, sacred sites of the tantras
glossary.ཐད: thad — straight at, right toward (thad): thad snying kar 'straight at the heart'
glossary.ཐར་པའི: thar pa'i — of liberation (thar pa 'liberation, freedom' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཐལ་ལོ: thal lo — perhaps it is finished, a closing word (thal 'to pass through, to have gone by' + the sentence-ending -lo); the sense is not sure
glossary.ཐིམ: thim — to dissolve, to be absorbed (thim)
glossary.ཐུགས་ཀ: thugs ka — heart, chest (thugs ka), the respectful word
glossary.ཐུགས་ཀར: thugs kar — in the heart, into the heart (thugs ka 'heart', respectful, + -r 'in, into')
glossary.ཐུགས་རྗེའི: thugs rje'i — of compassion (thugs rje 'compassion', respectful, + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཐུགས་རྗེས: thugs rjes — by compassion (thugs rje 'compassion', respectful, + -s 'by')
glossary.ཐོད་ཁྲག: thod khrag — skull and blood, a skull cup full of blood (thod 'skull' + khrag 'blood')
glossary.ཐོད་རྔ: thod rnga — skull drum (thod 'skull' + rnga 'drum'), a small double-headed drum
glossary.ཐོབ་ཅིག: thob cig — uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
glossary.ཐོས་གྲོལ: thos grol — liberation through hearing (thos 'hear' + grol 'be freed'); the Tibetan name of this book
glossary.ད་ལྟ: da lta — now, at present (da lta)
glossary.དཀར་མོ: dkar mo — white, a white one (dkar 'white' + -mo, feminine)
glossary.དཀྱིལ་འཁོར: dkyil 'khor — maṇḍala, the circle of a deity and his retinue (dkyil 'centre' + 'khor 'surround'; Sanskrit maṇḍala)
glossary.དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན: dge ba'i bshes gnyen — spiritual friend, teacher of virtue (dge ba 'virtue' + bshes gnyen 'friend'; Sanskrit kalyāṇamitra)
glossary.དགོངས་སུ: dgongs su — to heed, into the mind (dgongs, the respectful 'think', + -su 'into'): dgongs su gsol 'I pray, think of me'
glossary.དང: dang — and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
glossary.དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པ: dpag tu med pa — immeasurable (dpag 'measure' + tu + med pa 'without')
glossary.དཔའ་བོ: dpa' bo — hero (dpa' bo; Sanskrit vīra): in the tantras the male companions of the sky-goer women
glossary.དཔའ་མོ: dpa' mo — heroine (dpa' mo, the feminine of dpa' bo 'hero'): in the tantras a female companion of the sky-goers
glossary.དཔེ་བྱད: dpe byad — the minor marks, the eighty lesser signs of a buddha's body (dpe byad)
glossary.དབང་བའི: dbang ba'i — of having power, having power over (dbang ba 'to have power' + -'i 'of'): tshe la dbang ba'i 'having power over life'
glossary.དམ་ཉམས: dam nyams — one whose commitment is broken (dam, short for dam tshig 'commitment, vow', + nyams 'damaged'): the vows of tantric practice
glossary.དམ་ཚིག་ཅན: dam tshig can — one who has the commitment, keeper of vows (dam tshig 'commitment, vow' + can 'having'): one who holds the vows of tantric practice
glossary.དུར་ཁྲོད: dur khrod — charnel ground, burial ground (dur khrod)
glossary.དུས་གསུམ: dus gsum — the three times, past, present and future (dus 'time' + gsum 'three')
glossary.དུས་སུ: dus su — at the time (dus + su 'at')
glossary.དེ: de — that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
glossary.དེ་ཙ་ན: de tsa na — at that time, then (de 'that' + tsa na; a set phrase)
glossary.དེ་ཙམ: de tsam — so many, so much (de 'that' + tsam 'as much'): de tsam cig gi 'of so many'
glossary.དེ་རུ: de ru — to that, there (de 'that' + -ru 'to', a form of the particle la used, like -r, after a vowel)
glossary.དྲག་པོ: drag po — fierce, strong, violent (drag po)
glossary.དྲག་པོས: drag pos — by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
glossary.དྲང་དུ: drang du — to lead (drang, the future stem of 'dren 'lead', + -du 'to'): drang du gsol 'I pray that you lead'
glossary.ན: na — if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
glossary.ནང: nang — inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
glossary.ནས: nas — from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
glossary.ནི: ni — as for: marks the topic of the sentence
glossary.ཕན་ཆད་དུ: phan chad du — up to, until, from then on (phan chad 'up to, onward' + -du): da phan chad du 'until now'
glossary.ཕྱག་རྒྱ: phyag rgya — hand-seal, the gesture of the hands (phyag 'hand' + rgya 'seal'; Sanskrit mudrā)
glossary.ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོའི: phyag rgya chen po'i — of the Great Seal (phyag rgya chen po + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཕྱམ་ཕྱམ་པ: phyam phyam pa — perhaps gleaming (phyam phyam pa); the sense is not sure
glossary.བཀོལ་གཅོད: bkol gcod — taken as being worked and slaughtered (bkol, past of 'khol 'to put to work', + gcod 'to cut'); the sense is partly guessed
glossary.བཀྲག་མདངས་ཅན: bkrag mdangs can — having lustre and radiance, lustrous and radiant (bkrag 'lustre' + mdangs 'glow' + can 'having')
glossary.བག་ཆགས: bag chags — habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
glossary.བཅད་དུ: bcad du — to cut, to impose (bcad, the past stem of gcod 'cut', + -du 'to'): chad pa bcad du 'ong 'come to impose punishment'
glossary.བཅས: bcas — together with (bcas, the short form of bcas pa): dang bcas nas 'together with … and then'
glossary.བཅས་ཏེ: bcas te — together with (bcas + te; dang bcas te: 'along with')
glossary.བཅས་པ: bcas pa — together with, accompanied by (bcas pa): 'khor dang bcas pa 'together with the retinue'
glossary.བཅུའི: bcu'i — of ten (bcu 'ten' + -'i 'of'): gnas bcu'i 'of the ten places'
glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: bcom ldan 'das — the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.བཏང་ཅིག: btang cig — let go! (btang, the past stem of gtong 'let go', + cig, which marks a command; the imperative stem proper is thong); ma btang cig 'do not let go'
glossary.བཏབ་པས: btab pas — by having given, because it is given (btab pa + -s 'by') · because it is made, of a prayer (smon lam btab pas 'because the prayer is made')
glossary.བདེ་གཤེགས: bde gshegs — sugata, one gone to bliss, a buddha (bde gshegs, short for bde bar gshegs pa)
glossary.བཞིའི: bzhi'i — of four (bzhi 'four' + -'i 'of'); zhag phyed dang bzhi 'three and a half days'
glossary.བཟུང: bzung — held, seized (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold': 'dzin / bzung / gzung / zung): bzung yang ma zin pa 'held, yet not caught'
glossary.བཟུང་ཅིག: bzung cig — hold! (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold', + cig, which marks a command); the imperative stem proper is zung
glossary.བཟོད་པ: bzod pa — bearing, endurance (bzod 'bear, endure' + -pa): mi bzod pa 'unbearable'
glossary.བར་དོ: bar do — the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
glossary.བརྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: brtse gcig tu — perhaps one-pointedly, taken for rtse gcig tu (brtse itself is 'love' + gcig 'one' + tu); kept as printed, and the sense is not sure
glossary.བལྟ་སྟངས: blta stangs — manner of looking, gaze (blta, the future stem of lta 'to look', + stangs 'manner'; also written lta stangs)
glossary.བསགས་པ: bsags pa — gathered (bsags pa, bsags the past stem of gsog 'gather'): tshogs ma bsags pa 'who has not gathered the accumulations'
glossary.བསུ་བ: bsu ba — meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
glossary.བསོ་སྒྲ: bso sgra — perhaps a roar, another cry of the kind (bso sgra); the word bso is not known, and the sense is not sure
glossary.བསྒྲལ: bsgral — to free, freed (bsgral, the past and future stem of sgrol 'free'): bsgral nas 'having freed'
glossary.བྱ་བ: bya ba — called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
glossary.བྱེ་བྲག: bye brag — kind, sort, variety (bye brag): rol mo'i bye brag 'kinds of music'
glossary.བྱེད: byed — to do, doing (byed, the present stem; past byas): gar sna tshogs byed 'doing dances of many kinds'
glossary.བྱོན་པར: byon par — having come, come (byon, the past stem of 'byon, the respectful 'come', + -pa + -r): byon par 'dug gis 'have come, and so'
glossary.བྲོས: bros — fled, ran away (bros, past of 'bros 'flee')
glossary.བྲོས་ཤིག: bros shig — flee! (bros, imperative of 'bros 'to flee', + shig, which marks a command); ma bros shig 'do not flee'
glossary.མ: ma — not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
glossary.མཁའ་འགྲོ: mkha' 'gro — sky-goer, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go'; also written mkha' 'gro ma, with the feminine -ma)
glossary.མཁའ་འགྲོ་མ: mkha' 'gro ma — sky-goer woman, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go' + -ma, feminine; Sanskrit ḍākinī)
glossary.མཁའ་འགྲོ་མའི: mkha' 'gro ma'i — of sky-goer women, of ḍākinīs (mkha' 'gro ma + -'i 'of')
glossary.མཁའ་སྤྱོད: mkha' spyod — Sky-Faring (mkha' 'sky' + spyod 'move about, enjoy'; Sanskrit khecara): the realm of the beings who move in space
glossary.མཁྱེན: mkhyen — to know, to take heed (mkhyen, the respectful word for 'know'): khyed rnams mkhyen 'you all know, take heed'
glossary.མཉམ་དུ: mnyam du — together, along with (mnyam 'equal, same' + -du)
glossary.མདུན: mdun — perhaps longing, taken as 'dun pa in mdun brtse gcig tu (mdun itself is 'front'); the sense is not sure
glossary.མན་ཆད: man chad — from … downward, from then on (man chad): 'di man chad 'from this on'
glossary.མཚོན་སྐུད: mtshon skud — taken as coloured thread, for tshon skud (tshon 'colour, dye' + skud 'thread'); mtshon itself is 'weapon, sign'; the sense is taken from the context
glossary.མཛད: mdzad — to make, to do (mdzad, the respectful word for 'do'): gar mdzad 'make a dance'
glossary.མཛད་པ: mdzad pa — making, doing (mdzad pa, the respectful 'make')
glossary.མཛེས་པའི: mdzes pa'i — of the beautiful, beautiful (mdzes pa 'beautiful' + -'i 'of')
glossary.མི: mi — not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
glossary.མི་གསུར: mi gsur — burnt offering of human flesh, taken so (mi 'human' + gsur 'burnt offering of flour and food, for its smoke'); the sense is partly guessed
glossary.མེད་དོ: med do — there is not (med + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.མེར་མེར་བ: mer mer ba — flickering, as flames do (mer mer ba); the sense is approximate
glossary.མོས་གུས: mos gus — devotion and respect (mos 'devotion' + gus 'respect')
glossary.མོས་པ: mos pa — devotion, trust, interest (mos pa)
glossary.མྱོང: myong — to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
glossary.ཙམ: tsam — just, only, about · as much as, so much that (tsam): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'so loud as to split the head'
glossary.ཙམ་དུ: tsam du — just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
glossary.ཚོགས: tshogs — host, crowd, gathering (tshogs) · accumulation (of merit and wisdom), what is gathered (tshogs): tshogs ma bsags pa 'who has not gathered the accumulations'
glossary.ཞག: zhag — day, a day and night (zhag)
glossary.ཞི་བའི: zhi ba'i — of the peaceful, peaceful (zhi ba 'peaceful' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཞིང: zhing — and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm'
glossary.ཞིང་དུ: zhing du — to the realm, into the field (zhing 'realm, buddha-field' + -du 'to')
glossary.ཞིང་ལྤགས: zhing lpags — perhaps a flayed skin, the skin of a slain enemy (zhing 'field', in tantric speech the body of an enemy, + lpags 'skin'); the sense is not sure
glossary.ཞེན་ཅིག: zhen cig — cling! (zhen 'cling' + cig, which marks a command); ma zhen cig 'do not cling'
glossary.ཞེས: zhes — so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
glossary.ཟིན་པ: zin pa — seizing, holding; recognising (zin 'be seized, be held' + -pa): ngos mi zin pa 'one who does not recognise'
glossary.ཟུག: zug — to pierce, to stab, to stick in (zug)
glossary.འཁོར་བར: 'khor bar — in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
glossary.འཁྱམས་པའི: 'khyams pa'i — of wandering, when one wanders ('khyams 'wander' + -pa'i 'of')
glossary.འཁྲིལ: 'khril — to wind about, to embrace ('khril): 'khril zhing 'embracing, and'
glossary.འཁྲུལ་བའི: 'khrul ba'i — of delusion, deluded ('khrul 'be deluded' + -ba + -'i 'of'): ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'the impure appearances of delusion'
glossary.འགས་པ: 'gas pa — splitting, cracking ('gas pa 'to split, crack'): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'as much as splits the head'
glossary.འགུལ་འགུལ་དུ: 'gul 'gul du — quiveringly, in a quivering manner ('gul 'gul 'quiver', doubled, + -du 'in the manner of')
glossary.འཆར་དུ: 'char du — to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
glossary.འཆི་ཁའི: 'chi kha'i — of the point of death ('chi kha 'the brink of death' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཇའ་འོད་དུ: 'ja' 'od du — as rainbow light, into rainbow light ('ja' 'rainbow' + 'od 'light' + -du 'as, into')
glossary.འཇིག་རྟེན: 'jig rten — the world ('jig 'perish' + rten 'support': the perishable support)
glossary.འཇིགས་པའི: 'jigs pa'i — of fear, fearful, terrifying ('jigs pa 'fear' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཇིགས་ཤིག: 'jigs shig — be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
glossary.འདས་པ: 'das pa — gone beyond, passed ('das, the past stem of 'da' 'to pass beyond', + -pa): mtha' las 'das pa 'gone beyond the limit, boundless'
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དུ: 'di skad du — in these words, thus ('di 'this' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
glossary.འདིར: 'dir — here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
glossary.འདིར་བ: 'dir ba — perhaps booming, roaring, taken as ldir ba ('dir is the print's spelling; 'dir also means 'here'); the sense is a guess
glossary.འདུག་པས: 'dug pas — since it is, since it appears ('dug pa 'there is, it seems' + -s)
glossary.འདྲ་བ: 'dra ba — like, resembling ('dra ba): bdag 'dra ba 'one like me'
glossary.འཕྲང: 'phrang — narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
glossary.འཕྲོད: 'phrod — to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
glossary.འཕྲོད་པ: 'phrod pa — meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
glossary.འབྱུང་ངོ: 'byung ngo — occurs, arises ('byung 'occur' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mang du 'byung ngo 'occur in great number'
glossary.འབྱུང་བས: 'byung bas — because it happens, since it comes about ('byung 'occur' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འཛིན་པས: 'dzin pas — by holding, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -s 'by'): thod khrag 'dzin pas 'holding the skull of blood'
glossary.འཛུམ་པའི: 'dzum pa'i — smiling, of a smile ('dzum 'smile' + -pa + -'i 'of'): 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'a smiling radiance'
glossary.འུར་སྒྲ: 'ur sgra — din, roar ('ur sgra 'a sound of roaring')
glossary.འོང་བས: 'ong bas — because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འོད་གསལ: 'od gsal — clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
glossary.འོད་ལམ: 'od lam — light-path, path of light ('od 'light' + lam 'path')
glossary.ཡང: yang — also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
glossary.ཡན་ཆད: yan chad — from … upward, and everything above (yan chad): de yan chad 'that and all above it'
glossary.ཡུམ: yum — mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས: ye shes — wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས་སུ: ye shes su — as wisdom (ye shes 'wisdom' + -su 'as'): ye shes su ngo shes 'recognise as wisdom'
glossary.ཡོད་དོ: yod do — there is (yod 'there is' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.ཡོམ་ཡོམ: yom yom — swaying (yom yom), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
glossary.རང་ངོ: rang ngo — one's own face, its own nature (rang 'self' + ngo 'face')
glossary.རང་དུ: rang du — as its own, as itself (rang 'self' + -du 'as'): rig pa'i rang du 'as awareness itself'
glossary.རང་སྒྲ: rang sgra — own sound, natural sound (rang 'self' + sgra 'sound')
glossary.རང་སྣང: rang snang — self-appearance, one's own appearance (rang 'self' + snang 'appear'): what the mind itself shows
glossary.རིག་པའི: rig pa'i — of knowing, of awareness (rig pa 'knowing' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རིག་འཛིན: rig 'dzin — knowledge-holder (rig pa 'knowledge' + 'dzin 'hold'; Sanskrit vidyādhara): a master of tantric knowledge
glossary.རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: rigs kyi bu — child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
glossary.རིགས་འཛིན: rigs 'dzin — knowledge-holder (rigs 'dzin, this print's spelling of rig 'dzin)
glossary.རིགས་ལྔའི: rigs lnga'i — of the five families (rigs lnga + -'i 'of')
glossary.རུས་པའི: rus pa'i — of bone, made of bone (rus pa 'bone' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རོལ་དུ: rol du — at the side of, round about (rol 'side' + -du 'at'): rnams kyi rol du 'round them'; the usual word is phyi rol 'outside', and the sense is taken from the context
glossary.རྒྱ: rgya — seal (rgya; Sanskrit mudrā): rgya rgya rgya 'seal, seal, seal', the threefold seal at the end of a treasure text
glossary.རྒྱན: rgyan — ornament, adornment; to adorn (rgyan, the present stem; past brgyan)
glossary.རྒྱབ: rgyab — back, behind (rgyab): rgyab nas 'from behind'
glossary.རྣམས: rnams — plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
glossary.ལ: la — to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …')
glossary.ལམ་སྣ: lam sna — head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
glossary.ལས: las — from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
glossary.ལྔ་ལྡན: lnga ldan — having five (lnga 'five' + ldan 'have'), short for lnga dang ldan pa: 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'light having five colours'
glossary.ལྕགས་ཀྱུས: lcags kyus — by the hook (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -s 'by')
glossary.ལྗང: ljang — green (ljang): ljang khu 'green'; ljang la 'green and'
glossary.ལྟ་བུ: lta bu — like, of the kind of (lta bu)
glossary.ལྟ་བུའི: lta bu'i — like, of the kind of (lta bu 'like' + -'i): me long lta bu'i 'like a mirror'
glossary.ལྡན་པ: ldan pa — having, endowed with (ldan 'have, possess' + -pa)
glossary.ལྡན་བ: ldan ba — having, endowed with (ldan ba, this print's spelling of ldan pa)
glossary.ལྡིར་བ: ldir ba — roaring, booming (ldir ba, from ldir 'to boom, roar'): ldir ba tsam 'as much as roaring'
glossary.ལྷ་ཚོགས: lha tshogs — host of deities (lha 'god' + tshogs 'host, gathering')
glossary.ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི: lhan cig skyes pa'i — of the coemergent, born together (lhan cig 'together' + skyes pa 'born' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit sahaja): the wisdom born together with the mind itself
glossary.ལྷན་སྐྱེས: lhan skyes — coemergent, born together (lhan skyes, short for lhan cig skyes pa)
glossary.ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པའི: lhun gyis grub pa'i — of the spontaneously present, of what is present of itself (lhun gyis 'of itself, spontaneously' + grub pa 'be accomplished, be present' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཤ་སྟག་གོ: sha stag go — nothing but, all without exception (sha stag + the sentence-ending -go)
glossary.ཤར: shar — arisen, appeared (shar, past of 'char 'arise') · the east (shar): dkyil 'khor de'i shar nas 'from the east of that maṇḍala'
glossary.ཤིག་ཤིག: shig shig — shaking (shig shig), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
glossary.ས: sa — ground, earth; the earth element (sa) · a level of the bodhisattva's path (sa, Sanskrit bhūmi): sa la gnas pa 'dwelling on the levels'
glossary.སེམས་ཅན: sems can — sentient being, living creature (sems can)
glossary.སེར་མོ: ser mo — yellow, a yellow one (ser 'yellow' + -mo, feminine)
glossary.སྐུ་མདོག: sku mdog — body colour, colour of a buddha or deity (sku 'body' + mdog 'colour'), the respectful word
glossary.སྐྱེ་བར: skye bar — to be born, in being born (skye ba 'to be born' + -r): skye bar the tshom med 'there is no doubt of being born'
glossary.སྐྱེས: skyes — arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
glossary.སྐྱོར: skyor — to hold up, to support (skyor, the present stem, which also serves as the imperative 'hold up!'; past and future bskyor)
glossary.སྐྱོལ: skyol — bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
glossary.སྐྲག: skrag — to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
glossary.སྐྲག་ཅིག: skrag cig — be frightened! (skrag + cig, which marks a command); ma skrag cig 'do not be frightened'
glossary.སྐྲག་དངངས: skrag dngangs — fright and terror (skrag 'be frightened' + dngangs 'dread'): the same two words as dngangs skrag, in the other order
glossary.སྒྲ་གྲགས: sgra grags — sound, noise, din (sgra 'sound' + grags 'to sound, be heard'): sgra grags la ldir che ba 'loud of sound and great in booming'
glossary.སྒྲིལ་མ: sgril ma — twisted, rolled up (sgril 'to roll, to wind' + -ma)
glossary.སྙིང་ཀར: snying kar — at the heart, in the heart (snying ka 'heart' + -r 'at')
glossary.སྟེ: ste — and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
glossary.སྟོང: stong — empty · thousand (stong), as in 'brug stong 'a thousand thunderclaps'
glossary.སྣ་ཚོགས: sna tshogs — various, of many kinds (sna tshogs): gar sna tshogs 'dances of many kinds'
glossary.སྨོན་ལམ: smon lam — prayer of aspiration (smon 'to wish' + lam 'path')
glossary.སློབ་དཔོན: slob dpon — master, teacher (slob dpon; Sanskrit ācārya)
glossary.ཨ་ཙ་མ་ར: a tsa ma ra — alas! a cry of dismay (a tsa ma ra, kept as printed; the usual cry is a tsa ma re)
glossary.ཨྠྀི: ithi — iti, 'thus', the Sanskrit word that closes a text, written as one stacked sign (i-thi)

about: This part finishes the seventh day and closes the peaceful bardo. Round the knowledge-holder of full ripening, who dawned at the end of the last part, the four knowledge-holders of the directions appear, each with a sky-goer consort, dancing with curved knife and skull of blood: Dwelling on the Levels in the east, white; Power over Life in the south, yellow; the Great Seal in the west, red; Spontaneous Presence in the north, green. Around them come countless sky-goers, heroes and heroines, ging and guardians of the teaching, in bone ornaments, with drums, thigh-bone trumpets and banners of skin, filling every world and shaking it, to welcome those who keep their vows and punish those who broke them. From the hearts of the five knowledge-holders a light of the five colours of coemergent wisdom, like twisted coloured threads, strikes the dead man's heart, and beside it dawns the dull green light of the animals. He is not to fear the bright light or its roar of a thousand thunders, nor to be drawn to the dull one, which leads to birth as a dumb beast; he is to turn to the knowledge-holders, lament that so many deities have held him and not caught him, and ask them to draw him to the Sky-Faring realm with the hook of their compassion, in a prayer of eight lines. Whoever makes it dissolves into their hearts as rainbow light. The text then says that all who have had a spiritual friend are freed here, and even those of bad tendencies, and closes: this was the Great Liberation through Hearing for the bardo of the moment of death and the peaceful bardo of reality. Iti; seal, seal, seal.
